description: This file defines the LockingSessionConnection class, which extends StandardSessionConnection to add locking logic for DynamoDB read operations. It includes a constructor and a read method that attempts to acquire a lock with retries, handling exceptions specific to DynamoDB.

classes.name: LockingSessionConnection
classes.description: A subclass of StandardSessionConnection that adds locking mechanisms for DynamoDB read operations, including retry logic for acquiring locks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection with a DynamoDbClient and configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock on an item identified by $id, retries until timeout or success, and returns the item data.
